name: Sonic Youth

whyMatters.en: NYC noise-rock band formed in 1981. Alternate tunings and prepared guitar as composition method; Daydream Nation (1988) is the double-album peak.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约噪音摇滚乐队，1981 年成立。把另调弦与预制吉他当作曲方法；《Daydream Nation》（1988）是双专峰值。

note.en: Goo-era; Gordon vocal and Chuck D cameo.
note.zh: 《Goo》时期；Gordon 人声与 Chuck D 客串。

interviewQuotes.text: The tuning is the song before the song.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Thurston Moore

interviewQuotes.text: Kim’s voice and bass made the art-noise into songs.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Lee Ranaldo

lyricQuotes: It is an anthem for the kids of today
Kool thing sitting with a butt like that

shortBio.en: Alternate-tuning noise/indie, 1981–2011. Daydream Nation peak; shoegaze-adjacent textures.
shortBio.zh: 另调弦噪音/indie，1981–2011。《Daydream Nation》峰值；与 shoegaze 相邻的纹理。

body.en:
Sonic Youth formed in New York in 1981. From No Wave roots they moved through Sister and Daydream Nation. Moore and Ranaldo use alternate tunings, drumsticks under strings, and feedback as harmony. Goo and Dirty mark the major-label chapter; the band ended in 2011.

Narrative notes noise and shoegaze adjacency; genre tags stay alternative/indie-rock. Nirvana, MBV, and later indie cite the tunings and feedback harmony.
body.zh:
Sonic Youth 于 1981 年在纽约成立。从 No Wave 根走到《Sister》与《Daydream Nation》。Moore 与 Ranaldo 使用另调弦、弦下鼓棒，并把反馈当和声。《Goo》与《Dirty》标记大厂章节；乐队于 2011 年结束。

叙事提及噪音与 shoegaze 相邻；类型标签仍是 alternative/indie-rock。Nirvana、MBV 与后来 indie 引用调弦与反馈和声。

body.en:
Sonic Youth write by retuning first. Prepared guitar and feedback replace the usual blues solo. Songs still have hooks—noise is a writing method.

Bridge from No Wave to 1990s alternative radio.
body.zh:
Sonic Youth 先改调再写。预制吉他与反馈替换常见蓝调独奏。歌仍有钩子——噪音是一种写法。

从 No Wave 到 1990 年代 alternative 电台的桥。

body.en:
Shelley settles on drums in the mid-1980s. Peak: Moore, Gordon, Ranaldo, and Shelley on Daydream Nation through Dirty. O’Rourke later expands textures.

Peak flag on the late-1980s four.
body.zh:
Shelley 在 1980 年代中期固定鼓席。巅峰：Daydream Nation 至 Dirty 上的 Moore、Gordon、Ranaldo 与 Shelley。O’Rourke 后扩展纹理。

巅峰旗在 1980 年代末四人。

title.zh: 双吉他噪音、Gordon 贝斯/人声

body.en:
Moore and Ranaldo: interlocking dissonance, amp stacks. Gordon: spoken-sung bass songs. Shelley: motorik-leaning indie kit.

Shoegaze bands later borrow the wall; SY keeps NYC art-punk diction.
body.zh:
Moore 与 Ranaldo：交错不协和、音箱堆。Gordon：说唱式贝斯歌。Shelley：偏 motorik 的 indie 鼓。

后来 shoegaze 乐队借墙；SY 保留纽约艺术朋克咬字。

body.en:
Daydream Nation. Open-tuning shimmer, Moore vocal, long form without prog vanity.

Indie anthem built from noise tools.
body.zh:
《Daydream Nation》。开放调弦闪烁、Moore 人声、无 prog 虚荣的长曲式。

用噪音工具建成的 indie 圣歌。

body.en:
Goo. Gordon lead, hip-hop cameo, still detuned riffs. Noise method under major-label gloss.

1990 crossover face.
body.zh:
《Goo》。Gordon 主唱、嘻哈客串、仍是另调 riff。大厂抛光下的噪音方法。

1990 跨界脸。

title.en: Noise method for alt and shoegaze
title.zh: 给 alt 与 shoegaze 的噪音方法

body.en:
Nirvana, MBV, and later indie cite tunings and feedback harmony. Genre graph keeps SY under alternative; narrative owns the noise/shoegaze adjacency.

NYC art-noise that taught radio to tolerate abrasion.
body.zh:
Nirvana、MBV 与后来 indie 引用调弦与反馈和声。类型图把 SY 留在 alternative；叙事承认噪音/shoegaze 相邻。

教电台忍受磨损的纽约艺术噪音。

note.en: Prepared/alternate guitar as indie composition; noise and shoegaze adjacency in method.
note.zh: 预制/另调吉他作为 indie 作曲；方法上与噪音和 shoegaze 相邻。
